notes.title: Join the Discord!
notes.content:
Hey all!
Yes, I am here begging you to join the damn Discord. It's great I swear, we got... like, text channels and stuff. I dunno. Just join and we'll figure stuff out from there.

You get to talk to developers (me), you get to hear about announcements as they happen, you get to participate in events and early playtesting opportunities, all that stuff.

Idk. Just join, it might be fun

(The image below is actually a link. Fancy right? Click that and you'll be on)
